title: Item 9 Calibration — Stage A canonical evidence and sample sufficiency baseline
description: Start Item 9 by establishing an auditable per-risk-class calibration baseline after the canonical LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH pilots. This stage inventories only canonical explicit telemetry, records insufficient-data states without estimation, preserves current risk/gate/budget policy when evidence is insufficient, and freezes the staged path for deterministic calibration work.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Item 9 Stage A is MEDIUM and requires exact-artifact Review PASS plus ACTIVE lock evidence. Security and Project Owner Human Gate are not required unless effective risk escalates.

acceptance_criteria.description: Stage A records the canonical LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH pilot completion evidence and does not start until all three pilots are canonically complete.
Calibration inventory uses explicit canonical telemetry only. Missing .eqcofe/telemetry evidence is reported as missing and never replaced with estimates or synthetic usage.
LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH each receive an explicit sample-sufficiency disposition. With zero canonical primary samples, numeric token-budget calibration remains INSUFFICIENT_CANONICAL_TELEMETRY.
Stage A makes no risk-policy, verification-gate, token-budget, retry-limit, runtime, API, database, migration, dependency or workflow mutation.
The Item 9 document freezes the staged execution path A through D and requires later numerical recommendations to be deterministic, evidence-backed and fail closed when sample sufficiency is unmet.
Exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and Merge Policy pass before protected workflow merge, followed by exact-SHA post-merge verification before Stage A is called canonically complete.
